headline: SEA @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.03 at CLE 4.21, with a projected total of 8.24. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: SEA moved -0.23 runs while CLE moved +0.51, changing the projected margin by -0.74 runs. Pitching context: Luis Castillo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Travis Bazzana, Cole Young, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags David Fry, Rhys Hoskins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
